WITH book AS ( WITH book1 AS ( SELECT '1' seq , ast09_book.* FROM ast09_book WHERE ast09_company_id = #{companyId} AND (ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id, ast09_hold_date) IN ( SELECT ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id, MAX(ast09_hold_date) FROM ast09_book WHERE ast09_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast09_hold_date <= #{holdDate} AND ast09_ast_class_tree_id = #{astClassTreeId} GROUP BY ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id ) UNION ALL SELECT '2' seq , ast11_book_id , ast11_hold_date , ast11_ast_class_tree_id , ast11_keep_account_id , ast11_hold_qty , ast11_pur_amt , ast11_book_amt , ast11_eval_amt , ast11_eval_pl , ast11_first_pur_amt , ast11_first_pur_date , ast11_company_id , ast11_for_pur_amt , ast11_for_book_amt , ast11_for_eval_amt , ast11_for_eval_pl , ast11_fx_pl , ast11_book_end_yn , ast11_acr_int_amt , ast11_for_acr_int_amt , ast11_oci , ast11_for_oci , ast11_lock_up_period_cd , ast11_lock_up_date , ast11_lock_up_qty FROM ast11_book_close WHERE ast11_company_id = #{companyId} AND (ast11_ast_class_tree_id, ast11_keep_account_id, ast11_hold_date) IN ( SELECT ast11_ast_class_tree_id, ast11_keep_account_id, MAX(ast11_hold_date) FROM ast11_book_close WHERE ast11_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast11_hold_date < #{holdDate} AND ast11_ast_class_tree_id = #{astClassTreeId} GROUP BY ast11_ast_class_tree_id, ast11_keep_account_id ) ) SELECT * FROM book1 WHERE (ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id, to_char(ast09_hold_date,'yyyymmdd')||seq) IN ( SELECT ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id, MAX(to_char(ast09_hold_date,'yyyymmdd')||seq) FROM book1 GROUP BY ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id ) ) SELECT ast09_book_amt AS book_amt, ast09_hold_qty AS hold_qty FROM book WHERE COALESCE(ast09_book_end_yn,'false') != 'true'
